intent: Pull stated material out of the source with minimal reordering of meaning.
may_change: which spans are included (the excerpt boundary)
surface formatting (headings, list vs. prose) to fit the output surface
minor register smoothing where the excerpt is stitched into surrounding text
must_preserve: exact wording within an extracted span
the factual claims the span makes
attribution and provenance of the excerpt
numbers, quotations, and technical terms verbatim
the internal order of ideas within a single extracted span

new_claims.rationale: Extraction adds no assertion that was not already in the source; if the output says something the source did not, it has stopped being an extract.

source_fidelity.rationale: The output is the source, minus what was cut. Fidelity is near-verbatim by definition.

structure_rule: An extracted span keeps the source's own internal order; the only editorial decision is where the excerpt begins and ends.
verification_burden: verify-claims confirms the excerpt is not truncated in a way that reverses or hedges the original meaning, and that attribution survived the cut.
anti_patterns: Cutting a qualifying clause so the excerpt reads more strongly than the source intended
Stitching together non-adjacent spans without marking the cut
Extracting a number or quotation without its immediate qualifying context
